LATTE.gloss: strong espresso coffee with a topping of frothed steamed milk
LATTE.definition: Strong espresso coffee with a topping of frothed steamed milk.

LATE.gloss: being or occurring at an advanced period of time or after a usual or expected time
LATE.definition: Being or occurring at an advanced period of time or after a usual or expected time.

TALE.gloss: a message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events
TALE.definition: A message that tells the particulars of an act or occurrence or course of events; presented in writing or drama or cinema or as a radio or television program.

LET.gloss: make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen
LET.definition: Make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen.
LET.example: This permits the water to rush in.

TEA.gloss: a beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water
TEA.definition: A beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water.
TEA.example: Iced tea is a cooling drink.

ALE.gloss: a general name for beer made with a top fermenting yeast
ALE.definition: A general name for beer made with a top fermenting yeast; in some of the United States an ale is (by law) a brew of more than 4% alcohol by volume.

TEAL.example: They painted it a light shade of bluish green.
